title: LeBrown Jones
tagline: LeBrown Jones is a X/Twitter Agent personality for real time statistics and live NBA reactions. Lebrown Jones Terminal is a content creation platform to automatically generate multimodal media to honor and glaze the goat Lebron James.
description:
The project is aimed at being the first step toward fully autonomous and consistent social media presences. We have seen how popular X/Twitter agents such as aixbt, Luna,  and VaderAI are, and they are also tokenized and valued at millions of dollars. These agents are far from perfect and are limited to certain domains and platforms. My eventual goal was to start with building something similar, and then slowly extend it across platforms and use cases, developing a virtual character that is both useful and entertaining.

In this project, I explored the basics of building a Twitter agent that automatically posts, in this case pro-LeBron James propaganda and statistics. Additionally, I also built and hosted a web application with a LLM chat interface for fans/users of the LeBron fan personality to directly interact with. These represent two of the primary use cases for future extensions: a social media presence and a interactive terminal.
how_its_made: The primary technologies were Coinbase's Agent Kit for implementing the base Twitter agent, Twitter API, Tweetpy, Eleven Labs for Text-to-Speech and voice design for the character, Next.js for front end, Firework's for LLM API calls, Dobby by SentientAGI for zero-guardrails unhinged LLM output generation. Cursor for development, and Claude for ideation and refinement.
